title: Codepact configuration
description: Per-workspace error-code allocation for Soroban contracts. See SPEC.md.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, so editors validate and complete the file.

ranges.description: Maps a #[contracterror] enum name to the inclusive block of codes it owns.

propertyNames.description: A Rust enum identifier, exactly as declared.

additionalProperties.description: Inclusive [low, high] block. See SPEC.md rule 3.

ignore.description: Rule ids to suppress workspace-wide. Suppressing an error-severity rule is discouraged.
